cells.basis: alert.areas[0].kind_name「大津波警報：発表」(静岡県), alert.tsunami.highest_category=major_warning, alert.status=drill. The full official English name ("DRILL: Major Tsunami Warning") is 28 characters and cannot fit the 24-character en budget. en is shortened to "DRILL: Major Tsunami" so the drill prefix and "Major" stay. Downgrading to "Tsunami Warning" would weaken the warning.
